title: The guided walk: seven stops from Cortlandt St to the street

questions.question: What walk does the guide follow?
questions.answer: One step-free trip: enter Cortlandt St at Broadway, ride the R or W five stops, and walk out of 14 St-Union Sq to the street at 14th Street and 4th Avenue. It is the trip we filmed for the hackathon, with seven stops.

questions.question: What do I do at the Broadway entrance?
questions.answer: Enter through the glass doors at Cortlandt St. Turn right for the elevator down to the concourse. This is the step-free way in, and the recorded walk starts here.

questions.question: Which train do I take from Cortlandt St?
questions.answer: At the uptown platform, take the elevator marked Uptown & Queens. Board an R or W and ride five stops to Union Square.

questions.question: How do I leave the train at Union Square?
questions.answer: Leave the train at 14 St-Union Sq. Follow the platform to the elevator and go up one level to the mezzanine.

questions.question: Where do I turn on the mezzanine?
questions.answer: Turn left under the sign that says Elevator to L, and enter the long corridor. The camera read this exact sign on a saved frame, and the guide matches it to the mezzanine landing.

questions.question: How do I reach the street elevator?
questions.answer: Follow the corridor to the wide gate. Turn left at the orange mural and take the elevator to the street.

questions.question: How do I know I am outside?
questions.answer: You are outside at 14th Street and 4th Avenue. The Climate Clock across the street marks the end of the recorded route.

questions.question: Can I see the original footage at each stop?
questions.answer: Yes. Ask Design Baker to play the original walk at a stop and he opens the recorded clip for that checkpoint. Say Keep going and he returns to where you left off, even to the same second of a clip.
